t: Shello laasot melaka beereb shabbat min hammincha ulemala
s: Shello laasot melaka beereb shabbat min hammincha ulemala ubo h' seipim: aseru chakamim laasot melaka beereb shabbat veereb yom tob min hammincha ulemala. Vekol haoseh eno roeh simman beraka leolam meotah melaka, shemmah shemmarviach bah mapsid keneged zeh mimmaqom acher. Abal en oneshin oto aleha, lo nidduy velo makkot mardut kederek sheosin leober al dibre chakamim, lepi shello hechemiru kol kak beissur zeh. Umikkol maqom, goarin bo umebattelin oto millaasotah beal korcho:

Yesh omerim sheissur zeh hu min mincha gedola ulemala, dehaynu mishshesh shaot umechetza veelak. Veyesh omerim shehu mimmincha qetanna, dehaynu mittisha umechetza veelak. Uleinyan halaka, hammeqel bedibre soperim — lo hipsid habberaka:

Lo aseru ella melaka gemura, abal peraqmatya mutteret, ad shiur sheyyitbaer besimman rn"v. Vaapillu melaka gemura enah asura ella keshenniqba atzmo aleha, abal muttar laasot melaka lepi shaa derek aray, kegon im nizdammen lo liktob iggeret shelomim vekayyotze bazeh, shello aseru ella laasot melaka derek qeba, kede sheyyihyeh panuy lehitasseq betzorke shabbat. (Vaapillu mi sheeno tzarik kelal lehitasseq betzorke shabbat — asur lo laasot melaka min hammincha ulemala, lepi shello ratzu chakamim lechalleq bigzeratam). Vaapillu liqboa atzmo limlaka gemura en issur ella kesheenah letzorek hashshabbat, o apillu letzorek hashshabbat ella sheoseh besakar, abal laasot letzorek hashshabbat bechinnam, kegon litpor begadim letzorek hashshabbat, ben lo ben lachabero bechinnam — muttar kol hayyom. Veken muttar lehatiq separim lilmod bahem, ben shekkoteb leatzmo ben shekkoteb lachabero bechinnam, dekevan shehu debar mitzva — hare zeh kiltzorek shabbat:

Asur lesapper et hannokri beereb shabbat min hammincha ulemala, apillu tisporet shehi maaseh hedyot, vaapillu mesappero bechinnam, kevan sheen bimlaka zo tzorek hashshabbat. Abal muttar lesapper et yisrael kol hayyom, apillu maaseh umman, vaapillu besakar. Veeno domeh litpirat begadim ushear hammelakot, sheen haddabar nikkar shehammelaka naaset akshav bishbil hashshabbat, lepikak en hetter ella bechinnam (shekkesheyyittol sakar — hare zeh keillu naaset bishbil sekaro bilbad, veenah naaset kelal akshav bishbil hashshabbat), abal hattisporet nikkeret shennaaset akshav bishbil hashshabbat:

Mi shehu ani verotzeh laasot melaka lehistakker lehotzi hassakar letzorek shabbat — muttar lo laasot kol hayyom, shehare apillu bechol hammoed muttar lo laasot kol hammelakot al derek zeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqm"b, vekol shekken beereb shabbat min hammincha ulemala shehu qal mechullo shel moed, lepikak kol mah shemmuttar bechullo shel moed — kol shekken shemmuttar beereb shabbat kol hayyom apillu besakar:
